Desktop website previews with fixed 393 × 852 and 852 × 393 viewports.

- Cancel slow loads with Stop or return Home.
- Rotate without moving the window or resetting the page.
- Reopen recent URLs and clear saved history.
- Save viewport screenshots as PNGs in Pictures/PEW.

Download the Windows x64 setup executable below. SHA256SUMS.txt contains its checksum.

The installer is unsigned. Preview emulation and screenshot export currently require Windows.
